about: REST auth vectors, v5 (FINAL: matches crx-api http/auth.rs LoginWords::message, envelope_key and check_stamp at imbps-m7 c045cb81). Spec: SPEC-v5.md §10. EIP-191 personal_sign over the message lines joined by \n, no trailing newline. Body = keccak256 of the exact request bytes. Keys are public anvil test keys: never fund them. Computed by eth_account 0.14 and viem 2.57.2 (byte-equal); digests and signatures also equal under cast 1.5.1.
shape_note: 8 lines: CRX-REST-LOGIN, Audience, Method, Path, Custody, Signer, Timestamp, Body. Signer = x-crx-signer when sent (a delegate), else the custody.
